paragraphs: We are an offshore drilling contractor providing worldwide offshore drilling services to the oil and gas industry. Our primary business is the ownership and operation of drillships and semi-submersible rigs for operations in shallow to ultra-deepwater in both benign and harsh environments. We contract our drilling units to drill wells for our customers on a dayrate basis. Our customers include oil super-majors, state-owned national oil companies, and independent oil and gas companies. In addition, we provide management services to certain affiliated entities.

As of December 31, 2025, we owned a total of 15 drilling units, of which 10 were operating, one was undergoing capital upgrade projects for a contract commencing in the second quarter of 2026, one was undergoing repairs and maintenance projects and three were cold stacked. The 10 operating units include nine benign floaters (comprising six 7th generation drillships, two 6th generation drillships and one benign environment semi-submersible) and one harsh environment jackup. In addition to our owned assets, as of December 31, 2025, we managed two drilling units owned by Sonangol.

We are recognized for providing high quality operations, in some of the most challenging sectors of offshore drilling and have worldwide operations based on where activities are conducted in the global oil and gas industry. As of December 31, 2025, we employed approximately 3,000 employees across the globe.

Seadrill Limited (previously known as "Seadrill 2021 Limited") is an exempted company limited by shares incorporated under the laws of Bermuda and in accordance with the Bermuda Companies Act 1981 (the "Bermuda Companies Act"). Seadrill Limited was incorporated on October 15, 2021, under the name Seadrill 2021 Limited. On February 22, 2022 ("Effective Date"), Seadrill Limited and certain of its subsidiaries, that filed voluntary petitions for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code in the Bankruptcy Court emerged from bankruptcy proceedings in accordance with the terms and conditions of Seadrill's Plan of Reorganization. Seadrill Limited became the ultimate parent holding company of the Seadrill Limited group of companies (the "Group"), at which point its name was changed to Seadrill Limited ("Seadrill", "we", "us", "our", and "Company"). The Company is registered with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies under registration number 202100496.

From July 2, 2018, to the Effective Date, the ultimate parent holding company of the Group was Seadrill Limited, an exempted company limited by shares incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on March 14, 2018 with registration number 53439 ("Old Seadrill Limited").

Old Seadrill Limited was previously listed under the symbol "SDRL" on the NYSE and the Oslo Stock Exchange ("OSE"). On June 19, 2020, it was delisted from the NYSE and traded on the OTC Pink Market under the symbol "SDRLF". Following the Effective Date, trading of Old Seadrill Limited's shares was suspended on both exchanges.

On April 28, 2022, Seadrill Limited completed a listing of its common shares, par value $0.01 per share ("Shares" or "common shares"), on Euronext Expand. On October 11, 2022, Seadrill Limited received approval to relist its Shares on the NYSE under the ticker symbol "SDRL". The Shares commenced trading on October 14, 2022. Following the listing on the NYSE, the status of Seadrill Limited's listing on the Euronext Expand market of the OSE was changed from a primary to a secondary listing. On November 17, 2022, the Shares were moved from the Euronext Expand market to the main list of the OSE.

The Company submitted an application to delist its common shares on the OSE, on April 30, 2024. The last day of trading our common shares on the OSE was September 9, 2024, with our common shares being delisted from the OSE on September 10, 2024.
Our vision is to set the standard in deepwater oil and gas drilling, and we deliver this vision through the four pillars of our strategy:

Our objective is to unlock energy safely, efficiently, and responsibly for our clients globally. We strive to achieve this by maximizing asset availability through best-in-class operational performance, rigorous safety standards, and consistent execution. We are committed to maintaining safe and reliable operations through disciplined maintenance and continuous improvement. We also focus on driving cost efficiency across our operating model to strengthen reliability, reduce downtime, and deliver predictable performance for customers.

Maintaining a competitive fleet requires having the right rigs in the right areas, supported by a disciplined and focused portfolio. We upgrade and future-proof our fleet through targeted investments, technical enhancements, and planned reinvestment that improve performance and extend asset longevity. This approach enhances flexibility to meet evolving customer requirements and positions us for future growth. We apply prudent financial management to support disciplined investment, execute our strategy with resilience, and aim to continue creating sustainable value through cycles. By actively managing our portfolio, we strengthen operational resilience and protect long-term value creation.

We have established robust, long-term relationships with key customers and suppliers in the industry, and we seek to continuously deepen and strengthen these relationships further. We aim to do this by identifying strategic partnerships that are mutually beneficial and focused on delivering greater value through collaboration and execution excellence. In addition, we seek to diversify revenue streams by identifying value-adding services, improving how we support customers across the drilling lifecycle, and expanding opportunities aligned with our operational strengths. We strive to provide the best possible service and be valued partners in our customers' success.

We are proud of our culture, and we recognize that our business is built on people. We aim to recruit, retain, and develop the best talent in the industry and build a dynamic organization that adapts to evolving business needs. Developing internal talent and strengthening leadership depth are essential to delivering consistent performance and long-term competitiveness.
We categorize the drilling units in our fleet as (a) floaters, (b) jackup rigs and (c) harsh environment.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business and Industry
Consolidation in our industry may impact our results of operations.

Upgrades, refurbishment, repair and surveying of rigs are subject to risks, including delays and cost overruns, that could have an adverse impact on our available cash resources and results of operations.
Changing sentiments with respect to environmental, social and governance matters and climate change may impact us.
Our aspirations, goals and initiatives related to sustainability, including emissions reduction and our public statements and disclosures regarding the same, expose us to numerous risks.
Failure to obtain or retain highly skilled personnel, and to ensure they have the correct visas and permits to work in the locations in which they are required, could adversely affect our operations.
Our customers may seek to cancel or renegotiate their contracts to include unfavorable terms such as unprofitable rates, particularly in the circumstance that operations are suspended or interrupted.
We may not be able to renew or obtain new and favorable contracts for our drilling units.
Our contract backlog for our fleet of drilling units may not be realized.
Operating and maintenance costs of our rigs may be significant and may not correspond to revenue earned.
Inflation has adversely affected, and in the future may adversely affect, our operating results.
We have experienced, and in the future may experience, risks associated with mergers, acquisitions or dispositions of businesses or assets or other strategic transactions.
The integration of the businesses and the properties we have acquired or may in the future acquire could be difficult and may divert management's attention away from our existing operations.
Our fleet is largely concentrated to benign floaters and drillships, which leaves us vulnerable to risks related to lack of diversification.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the following risk factors in addition to the other information included in this report. Each of these risk factors could affect our business, operating results and financial condition, as well as affect an investment in our Shares. Unless otherwise indicated, all information concerning our business and our assets is as of December 31, 2025. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business operations.

Our business depends on the level of activity in the oil and gas industry. Adverse developments affecting the industry, including a decline in the price of oil or gas, reduced demand for oil and gas products and increased regulation of drilling and production, have in the past had and may in the future have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Our business depends on the level of oil and gas exploration, development and production in offshore areas worldwide that is influenced by oil and gas prices and market expectations of potential changes in these prices.

Oil and gas prices and the level of activity in offshore oil and gas exploration and development are extremely volatile and are affected by numerous factors beyond our control, including, but not limited to, the following:

•worldwide production of, and demand for, oil and gas, geographical dislocations in supply and demand, and our customers' views of future demand for oil and gas, which are impacted by changes in the rate of economic growth in the global economy;
•the cost of exploring for, developing, producing and delivering oil and gas; •expectations regarding future energy prices and production;

paragraphs: In this section, we present management's discussion and analysis of results of operations and financial condition. It should be read in conjunction with our Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying notes thereto included in this annual report for the year ended December 31, 2025. You should also carefully read the following sections of this annual report entitled "Forward-Looking Statements," Part I, Item 1, "Business" and Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors".

The discussion of our results of operations and liquidity in this section includes comparisons for the years ended December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024. Seadrill Limited (along with any one or more of its consolidated subsidiaries, or to all such entities, referred to as "Seadrill", "we", "us", "our", and "the Company") is an offshore drilling contractor providing worldwide offshore drilling services to the oil and gas industry. Our primary business is the ownership and operation of drillships and semi-submersible rigs for operations in shallow to ultra-deepwater in both benign and harsh environments. We contract our drilling units to drill wells for our customers on a dayrate basis. Our customers include oil super-majors, state-owned national oil companies, and independent oil and gas companies. In addition, we provide management services to certain affiliated entities.

As of December 31, 2025, we owned a total of 15 drilling units, of which 10 were operating, one was undergoing capital upgrade projects for a contract commencing in the second quarter of 2026, one was undergoing repairs and maintenance projects and three were cold stacked. The 10 operating units include nine benign floaters (comprising six 7th generation drillships, two 6th generation drillships and one benign environment semi-submersible) and one harsh environment jackup. In addition to our owned assets, as of December 31, 2025, we managed two drilling units owned by Sonangol.
For a detailed description of our business, please read Part I, Item 1, "Business".

Ongoing and recently proposed changes to U.S. global trade policy, along with potential international retaliatory measures, have continued to cause high volatility in global markets and uncertainty around short- and long-term economic impacts in the U.S., including concerns over inflation, recession and slowing growth. We continue to evaluate and monitor the potential impacts of these changes and measures, including the imposition of tariffs and any legal challenges to such tariffs, on our business and operations; however, it is not possible to predict the impact, if any, of any changes or proposed changes to the U.S. global trade policy, or any international retaliatory measures, on our business and operations.

In recent years, oil prices have generally remained at levels that support offshore exploration and development activity, where global rig demand has been steady. This level of demand was sustained by the combination of commodity prices, heightened focus on energy security, and relative attractiveness of offshore plays with respect to both cost and carbon emissions.
The price of Brent oil averaged $68 per barrel in 2025, down from $80 per barrel in 2024. Global growth in oil production and slower growth in demand have put downward pressure on prices.

Uncertainty persists in the market, particularly in light of concerns over global economic conditions, government trade policies and output increases by the OPEC and other major international producers. This has led to the continued deferral of offshore capital expenditures and contracting of offshore drilling services and could have a negative impact on near-term future demand for offshore drilling services. In addition, inflationary pressures may impact the cost base in our industry, including personnel costs and the prices of goods and services required to reactivate or operate rigs. As anticipated, 2025 was a year marked by softer utilization and a corresponding increase in competition, placing downward pressure on near term dayrates; however, as global tendering activity accelerates, we see signs that point towards a market recovery in 2027. In addition, we believe oil majors are calling for renewed focus on large-scale exploration and investment, and there is also growing consensus that U.S. shale production is plateauing. As a result, with projections of growing oil and gas demand and the lagging energy transition, operators are pivoting back towards deepwater exploration in order to replace reserves and sustain production growth.
Marketed utilization decreased in 2025 compared to the prior year, mainly due to fewer contracted floaters, which were primarily benign environment semi-submersibles.
Marketed utilization for harsh environment floaters and jackups declined in 2025 compared to the prior year, primarily reflecting reduced capital spending on drilling activities.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家離岸鑽井承包商，提供全球離岸鑽井服務予油氣產業。本公司主要業務為擁有並營運鑽井船與半潛式鑽井平台，用以執行淺水至超深水的鑽井作業，適用於溫和與嚴苛環境。本公司以每日費率方式將鑽井設備出租予客戶，用以為客戶鑽井。本公司客戶包括油氣超級大廠、國營國家油公司及獨立油氣公司。此外，本公司亦為某些關聯機構提供管理服務。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司共擁有15部鑽井設備，其中10部為運作中，1部進行2026年第二季起生效合約的資本升級計畫，1部進行維修與保養計畫，3部為冷堆存。運作中的10部設備包括9部溫和環境浮動鑽井平台（包含6部第七代鑽井船、2部第六代鑽井船及1部溫和環境半潛式鑽井平台）與1部嚴苛環境自升式鑽井平台。除本公司所有設備外，截至2025年12月31日，本公司亦管理屬於Sonangol所有的2部鑽井設備。
本公司以在離岸鑽井最具挑戰性的領域提供高品質作業而聞名，並在全球油氣產業活動進行的地區設有全球運作。截至2025年12月31日，本公司在全球僱用約3,000名員工。

Seadrill Limited（先前稱為"Seadrill 2021 Limited"）為根據伯明翰公司法1981年（"伯明翰公司法"）設立的豁免有限公司，註冊於伯明翰法律體系下。Seadrill Limited於2021年10月15日以Seadrill 2021 Limited之名設立。2022年2月22日（"生效日"），Seadrill Limited與部分子公司根據美國破產法第11章提出自願重組申請，並依照Seadrill重組計畫的條件完成破產程序。Seadrill Limited成為Seadrill Limited集團公司（"集團"）的最終母公司，此時其名稱變更為Seadrill Limited（"Seadrill"、"我們"、"我們"、"我們"及"本公司"）。本公司已於伯明翰公司註冊處註冊，註冊編號為202100496。
自2018年7月2日至生效日，集團的最終母公司為Seadrill Limited，為根據伯明翰法律設立的豁免有限公司，於2018年3月14日註冊，註冊編號為53439（"舊Seadrill Limited"）。
舊Seadrill Limited先前於紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）及挪威證券交易所（"OSE"）以符號"SDRL"上市。2020年6月19日，其從紐約證券交易所除牌，並於OTC Pink市場以符號"SDRLF"交易。自生效日起，舊Seadrill Limited股票在兩交易所的交易已暫停。

2022年4月28日，Seadrill Limited完成其普通股（每股面值0.01美元）於Euronext Expand市場的上市。2022年10月11日，Seadrill Limited獲批准於紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）以符號"SDRL"重新上市。普通股於2022年10月14日開始交易。上市紐約證券交易所後，Seadrill Limited於OSE的Euronext Expand市場上市地位由主要上市變為次要上市。2022年11月17日，普通股自Euronext Expand市場移至OSE的主市場。
本公司於2024年4月30日提交申請，將普通股從OSE除牌。本公司普通股在OSE的最後交易日為2024年9月9日，普通股於2024年9月10日正式從OSE除牌。
我們的願景是設立深水油氣鑽井的標準，我們透過策略的四大支柱來實現這個願景：
我們的目標是為全球客戶安全、高效且負責任地開發能源。我們透過最佳等級的運營表現、嚴謹的安全標準及一致的執行來達成此目標。我們致力於透過嚴謹的維護及持續改進，維持安全且可靠的運作。我們同時聚焦於透過優化運營模式來提升成本效益，以強化可靠性、減少停機時間，並為客戶提供可預測的表現。
維持競爭力的船隊需要在正確的地區擁有正確的鑽井平台，並透過嚴謹且專注的資產組合來支撐。我們透過針對性的投資、技術升級及計畫性的再投資來升級並未來化船隊，以提升表現並延長資產壽命。此方法增強了靈活性，以應對客戶需求的變化，並為未來成長奠定基礎。我們運用謹慎的財務管理來支持嚴謹的投資，執行策略時展現韌性，並致力於透過週期持續創造可持續的價值。透過積極管理資產組合，我們強化運營韌性並保護長期價值創造。
我們已與產業中的關鍵客戶及供應商建立了穩健且長遠的關係，我們致力於進一步深化並強化這些關係。我們透過識別具有雙贏效益的戰略合作夥伴，並專注於透過合作與執行卓越來提供更高的價值，來達成此目標。此外，我們透過識別價值增加的服務、改善我們在鑽井生命週期中對客戶的支持方式，以及拓展與我們運營優勢相符的機會，來多元化收入來源。我們致力於提供最佳的服務，並成為客戶成功的重要夥伴。
我們為自己的文化感到自豪，我們認知到業務的根基在於人才。我們致力於招募、留住並培養業界最佳的人才，並建立一個能適應業務需求變化的動態組織。培養內部人才並強化領導深度，是實現持續表現與長期競爭力的關鍵。
我們將船隊中的鑽井單位分為 (a) 浮動式鑽井平台、(b) 打樁式鑽井平台及 (c) 惡劣環境鑽井平台。

Seadrill Limited（連同其合併子公司之一或多個，或所有這些實體，簡稱為"Seadrill"、"我們"、"我們公司"、"我們的"及"本公司"）是一家 offshore 鑽井承包商，為油氣產業提供全球 offshore 鑽井服務。我們的主要業務為擁有並營運鑽井船與半潛式鑽井平台，用於淺水至超深水的環境，包括溫和與嚴苛環境。我們以日租費的方式將鑽井單元出租給客戶，為客戶鑽井。我們的客戶包括油氣超級大公司、國有國家油公司及獨立油氣公司。此外，我們也為某些關聯實體提供管理服務。

截至2025年12月31日，我們共擁有15部鑽井單元，其中10部為運作中，1部進行2026年第二季開始的合約資本升級工程，1部進行維修與保養工程，3部為冷堆存。運作中的10部鑽井單元包括9部溫和環境浮動鑽井單元（包含6部第七代鑽井船、2部第六代鑽井船及1部溫和環境半潛式鑽井平台）與1部嚴苛環境自升式鑽井平台。除了我們所有的資產，截至2025年12月31日，我們也管理2部由Sonangol所有的鑽井單元。
如需詳細說明我們的業務，請閱讀第一部分，項目1，"業務"。
美國全球貿易政策持續及最近提出的變更，以及潛在的國際報復措施，持續造成全球市場高波動性，並對美國短期與長期經濟影響產生不確定性，包括對通貨膨脹、經濟衰退與成長放緩的擔憂。我們持續評估與監測這些變更與措施，包括關稅的課徵與任何對這些關稅的法律挑戰，對我們業務與營運的潛在影響；然而，無法預測任何變更或擬議變更美國全球貿易政策，或任何國際報復措施，對我們業務與營運的影響，如有任何影響。
下表顯示2021年至2025年的平均年度原油價格。2026年2月20日的布倫特原油價格為每桶72.23美元。
近年來，原油價格普遍維持在支撐離岸探勘與開發活動的水準，全球鑽井需求則保持穩定。此需求水準由商品價格、對能源安全的關注度提高，以及離岸油田在成本與碳排放方面的相對吸引力所支撐。
2025 年布倫特原油平均價格為每桶 68 美元，較 2024 年每桶 80 美元為低。全球石油生產量的成長與需求成長放緩，對價格造成下行壓力。

市場仍存在不確定性，特別是在全球經濟狀況、政府貿易政策以及 OPEC 及其他主要國際生產國產量增加的擔憂之下。這導致離岸資本支出持續延後，離岸鑽井服務 contracted，可能對近期離岸鑽井服務需求產生負面影響。此外，通貨膨脹壓力可能影響我們產業的成本基礎，包括人力成本以及重新啟動或運作鑽井平台所需商品與服務的價格。如預期所見，2025 年是利用率較低且競爭相對增加的一年，對近期日租率造成下行壓力；然而，隨著全球招標活動加速，我們看到市場在 2027 年恢復的跡象。此外，我們認為石油大廠正呼籲重新聚焦於大規模探勘與投資，同時也逐漸達成共識認為美國頁巖油產能已趨於平台。因此，預測石油與天然氣需求將成長，而能源轉型進度落後，營運商正轉向深水探勘，以取代儲備並維持產能成長。
2025 年 marketed utilization 相較於前一年減少，主要原因是 contracted floaters 減少，這些 floaters 主要是溫和環境的半潛式鑽井平台。
2025 年 harsh environment floaters 和 jackups 的 marketed utilization 相較於前一年減少，主要反映鑽井活動的資本支出減少。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們產業的整併可能影響我們的營運成果。
鑽井平台的升級、翻新、維修及測繪工作，受到風險影響，包括延誤及成本超支，這些風險可能對我們的現金資源及營運成果產生不利影響。
關於環境、社會及治理議題以及氣候變遷的觀感變化，可能影響我們。
我們在可持續性方面的願景、目標及計畫，包括減排措施，以及我們公開聲明及揭露的相關資訊，使我們面臨許多風險。
未能取得或留住高素質人才，並確保他們擁有在所需地區工作的正確簽證及許可，可能對我們的營運產生不利影響。
我們的客戶可能尋求取消或重新談判其契約，以包含不利的條款，例如無利潤的費率，特別是在營運中斷或受阻的情況下。
我們可能無法續約或取得新的有利契約，用以使用我們的鑽井單元。
本公司鑽井單位的合約待執行業務可能無法實現。
本公司 rigs 的營運及維護成本可能相當顯著，且可能與所賺取的營業收入不一致。
通貨膨脹已對我們的營運成果產生負面影響，未來亦可能產生負面影響。
本公司已經驗過，且未來可能經驗過，與併購或處分業務或資產或其他戰略交易相關的風險。
本公司所取得或未來可能取得之業務與資產的整合可能困難，且可能使管理階層的注意力轉移至現有營運之外。
本公司 fleet 主要集中於良性浮動平台及鑽探船，這使我們面臨缺乏多元化所相關的風險。
paragraphs: 您應仔細考量下列風險因素，並配合本報告所包含的其他資訊。這些風險因素可能影響我們的業務、營運結果與財務狀況，以及對投資我們股票的影響。除非另有說明，所有關於我們業務與資產的資訊皆為2025年12月31日的資料。下列所述的風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不重要，也可能影響我們的業務營運。
我們的業務取決於油氣產業的活動程度。影響產業的不利發展，包括油氣價格下跌、油氣產品需求減少以及對鑽井與生產的規範增加，過去曾對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生重大不利影響，未來亦可能產生相同影響。
我們的業務取決於全球各 offshore 區域的油氣探勘、開發與生產活動，而這些活動受油氣價格與市場對這些價格潛在變動的預期所影響。
油氣價格與 offshore 油氣探勘與開發活動的水準極具波動性，且受許多超出我們控制範圍的因素影響，包括但不限於以下因素：
•全球油氣的生產與需求、供應與需求的地理失衡，以及客戶對未來油氣需求的觀點，這些因素受全球總體經濟成長率變動的影響；
•探勘、開發、生產與交付油氣的成本；•對未來能源價格與生產的預期；
